verified_eligible_batters.name: Fakhar Zaman
verified_eligible_batters.verification_notes: 183.89 Strike rate under pressure in international powerplay and chase situations.
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Aggressive top-order disruptor; counters extreme high required run rates and fast bowling in powerplays.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Asif Khan
verified_eligible_batters.verification_notes: Holds highest strike rate under pressure (196.52 SR) among verified uncontracted entrants with 37.67 avg.
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: High-impact budget finisher at No. 6/7; unmatched 196.52 pressure strike rate to close out chases.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Najibullah Zadran
verified_eligible_batters.verification_notes: 42.00 pressure average and 180.00 SR across high-stakes international fixtures; lethal death-overs hitting.
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Left-handed death enforcer; high boundary frequency against both express pace and mystery spin.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Angelo Mathews
verified_eligible_batters.verification_notes: 176.14 strike rate under pressure with elite boundary avoidance (only 20.5% dot ball rate).
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Crisis-management specialist; calm middle-overs stabilizer who accelerates without chewing dot balls.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Jason Holder
verified_eligible_batters.verification_notes: 63 pressure wickets across career; 9.50 pressure economy and 151.88 pressure batting strike rate.
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Dual-discipline balance; provides steep bounce on Jaipur surfaces and 150+ SR lower-order muscle.

verified_eligible_batters.name: Mohammad Nawaz
verified_eligible_batters.verification_notes: Stunning 5.87 pressure economy (best among qualified bowlers) and 144.50 pressure batting strike rate.
verified_eligible_batters.why_target: Defensive bank in high RRR scenarios; 42.4% dot ball rate chokes scoring while adding batting depth.
